newsitem.title: INDIA: ABN AMRO's Kumar reaction to Indian flux.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO's Kumar reaction to Indian flux.

text.p: Ravi Kumar, chief forex dealer at ABN AMRO Bank NV in Bombay, on Saturday gave Reuters the following view on Indian markets after the United front alliance was defeated in a confidence motion and a search for a new coalition got underway.
"The overall investment climate won't suffer. People take a long term view."
"These things were discounted when a coalition government was formed and when Kesri was elected Congress chief."
"It looks like the budget will go through (despite the fall of the Deve Gowda government). It is a good sign -- economic issues are separated from political issues."
"If the budget goes through it will reaffirm faith in India."
"Irrespective of differences, politicians understand India has huge economic potential waiting to be realised."
"On the debt side, money will continue to come in. Short-term (overseas) flows into equity may be affected."
